crm.apiKey.label: GoHighLevel Private Integration Token
crm.apiKey.help: LeadConnector Private Integration Token used as a Bearer credential (fallback: GHL_API_KEY env var).

crm.locationId.label: GoHighLevel Location ID
crm.locationId.help: Sub-account (location) id. Required for contact search (fallback: GHL_LOCATION_ID env var).

crm.apiVersion.label: GoHighLevel API Version
crm.apiVersion.help: LeadConnector versioning header. Defaults to 2021-07-28 (fallback: GHL_API_VERSION env var).

crm.baseUrl.label: GoHighLevel Base URL
crm.baseUrl.help: LeadConnector API base URL override (default https://services.leadconnectorhq.com).
